mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and 97 degrees at Fireman's Park. Tonight, under the full moon, keep your eyes peeled at 9:40 PM as the International Space Station makes a brief one-minute appearance, tracking from the west-southwest near Mount Horeb toward the southwest. We expect a low of 68 degrees overnight with no rain in the forecast.

The City Clerk is looking for student designs for the official I Voted sticker, while the Senior Center continues to offer free trishaw rides on the Military Ridge State Trail, though you will need to sign a liability waiver first.

Today you can head to Yoga at Insight Wellness, and tomorrow is packed with options like trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Louie, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the downtown farmer's market coming up this Wednesday.
In terms of public safety, the police department reported that on July 25, a 29-year-old woman was arrested for an O-W-I, which was her first offense.
The flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl, and the store is open until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a cold treat.
